description: Source code for a server-side script that manages a local HTTP server for layout test rebaselining, including configuration, baseline gathering, and server setup.

classes.name: TestConfig
classes.description: Configuration holder for test parameters including port, directories, platforms, and host.

classes.name: RebaselineServer
classes.description: A server class extending AbstractLocalServerCommand to handle rebaselining layout tests, including baseline gathering and server initialization.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TestConfig and RebaselineServer instances.

methods.name: _gather_baselines
methods.description: Collects and updates test baselines in the results JSON for tests that did not pass or run as expected.

methods.name: _prepare_config
methods.description: Prepares server configuration by loading results JSON, gathering baselines, and setting up test configuration.
